title: Family Night Under the Stars returns Nov. 20-21 with overnight camping at El Progreso Park
excerpt: The City of Laredo and District 5 Council Member Ruben Gutierrez, Jr. invite families to the 6th Annual Family Night Under the Stars, an overnight camping event Friday, Nov. 20 through Saturday, Nov. 21 at Jovita Idar's El Progreso Park.
content:
The City of Laredo and District 5 Council Member Ruben Gutierrez, Jr. invite families to the 6th Annual Family Night Under the Stars, an overnight camping event set for Friday, Nov. 20 through Saturday, Nov. 21 at Jovita Idar's El Progreso Park, 6002 Thomas Ave.

The event runs from 4 p.m. Friday to 10 a.m. Saturday. Families can bring their camping gear for a night under the Laredo sky, with a movie under the stars, paddle boats, archery, fishing, lawn games, and arts and crafts, according to the City of Laredo.

Live music by Bucket of Six is scheduled from 6 to 8 p.m. RVs are welcome. For details, the city lists 956-791-7309.

Sources: City of Laredo - Government, November 8, 2026.
